product: Metastore-level ABAC policies are in Beta
tagline: Metastore level ABAC policies are in Beta in Unity Catalog.
what_it_does: Metastore level ABAC policies are in Beta in Unity Catalog. You can now attach an ABAC policy (row filter, column mask, GRANT, or DENY) at the metastore level, so a single policy applies across every catalog in the metastore, including catalogs created later. This gives governance teams one place to enforce organization wide data protection rules without replicating a policy for each catalog.
why_it_matters: This gives governance teams one place to enforce organization wide data protection rules without replicating a policy for each catalog.
